## Preface

This book presents a practical analysis of e-commerce customer data to extract actionable insights for business strategy. Throughout these topics, we examine customer behavior patterns, identify meaningful trends, and demonstrate how data analysis techniques can inform e-commerce decision-making.

The analysis draws from the [Kaggle E-Commerce Customer Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/iyadavvaibhav/ecommerce-customer-device-usage), which contains valuable metrics on customer interactions, device preferences, and purchasing habits. My goal is to provide readers with a framework for transforming raw data into strategic business intelligence.
